responsibility: Serializes the effective command-line option set into the LTO options section of object files. It builds the quoted COLLECT_GCC_OPTIONS-style string that later drives option merging and replay, selecting relevant common/target/LTO options, suppressing frontend-, driver-, and diagnostic-only switches, preserving defaults whose meaning depends on target state such as PIC/PIE or cf-protection, and adding offload-specific options from target hooks when streaming offload LTO. Its output is the stable options payload consumed by lto-wrapper and later LTO stages.
